definitions.explanation: The ejection of lava, ash, and gases from a volcano.

examples.japanese: ⟦{富士山|ふじさん}→富士山：09514_fujisan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{噴火|ふんか}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧300⟦{年|ねん}→年：00486_toshi⟧⟦{以上|いじょう}→以上：01308_ijou⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧だ。
examples.english: The last time Mt. Fuji erupted was over 300 years ago.
The volcanic eruption caused a lot of damage.

examples.japanese: {噴火|ふんか}⟦{警報|けいほう}→警報：09515_keihou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発令|はつれい}→発令：09516_hatsurei⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A volcanic eruption warning was issued.

notes:
{噴火|ふんか} specifically refers to volcanic eruptions. Japan sits on the Pacific Ring of Fire and has over 100 active volcanoes, making this a practically important word.

COMPOUND: {噴|ふん} (spew/erupt) + {火|か} (fire)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {噴火|ふんか}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to erupt
- ⟦{噴火口|ふんかこう}→噴火口：27349_funkakou⟧: volcanic crater/vent
- {噴火|ふんか}⟦{警報|けいほう}→警報：09515_keihou⟧: eruption warning
- ⟦{大噴火|だいふんか}→大噴火：27350_daifunka⟧: major eruption
- {噴火|ふんか}⟦{活動|かつどう}→活動：00201_katsudou⟧: volcanic activity

RELATED VOLCANIC TERMS:
- ⟦{火山|かざん}→火山：04020_kazan⟧: volcano
- ⟦{溶岩|ようがん}→溶岩：13328_yougan⟧: lava
- ⟦{火山灰|かざんばい}→火山灰：19412_kazanbai⟧: volcanic ash
- ⟦{火口|かこう}→火口：00448_kakou⟧: crater
- ⟦{噴煙|ふんえん}→噴煙：19155_funen⟧: volcanic smoke/plume
